description: Async query: waits (default 1000 ms) until the element appears. Equivalent to `waitFor(() => getBy*(...))`.
Retries a callback until it stops throwing. Use for non-query assertions such as mock calls.
`vi.fn()` / `jest.fn()`: records calls (`mock.calls`) and can return or resolve canned values.
Intercepting requests (MSW, or `mockApi` in the Dojo) so components keep their real fetching code while tests control responses.
`true` for status 200-299. `fetch` does not reject on HTTP errors, so check it yourself.
